name: one-for-all-screens
description: One screen for every device, and every device checking the one screen. Lay a browser game's screen out at one reference size and scale the whole of it into any frame, the way an engine scales its canvas, with a foundation that re-measures safe-area insets an app's web view reports late, and a check that opens the game at real device sizes and reports every element that moves and every line of text that leaves its box.
